local_sid_metric_definitions.p95_collision_group_size: nearest p95 of full-path buckets with more than one item; 0 when none
local_sid_metric_definitions.cur_total: mean over SID levels of used_codes / configured_codebook_size
local_sid_metric_definitions.code_gini: Gini coefficient of full-path item-count distribution
local_sid_metric_definitions.code_entropy: natural-log Shannon entropy of full-path item-count distribution
local_sid_metric_definitions.prefix_coherence_at_n: equal-weight mean of within-prefix mean pairwise cosine similarities
local_sid_metric_definitions.intra_code_similarity: prefix_coherence at the full SID depth
local_sid_metric_definitions.valid_sid_rate: fraction of rows whose every SID component is within its configured codebook range
